result.instruction: Replace the up-counter with an 8-bit phase register that resets to `8'hFF` and decrements each non-reset clock, relying on 8-bit wraparound. Compute the registered output from the old phase as `phase > ~duty`; this is equivalent to the original `counter < duty` when `phase` is the bitwise complement of the original count. Preserve synchronous reset of `pwm_out` to zero and all existing ports; promote only if the unchanged verification gates pass and routed LUT count is strictly below 7.
